title: OTA model rollout with canary and automatic rollback
scenario: Corvane's ten gateways get new pump-health models by hand on Sundays; last month a model that crashed on the newer rev2 boards took four gateways offline for a day. Build a rollout controller over a simulated fleet: canary, phased batches, health gates per window, automatic rollback, offline devices handled, resumable after its own crash.
task: Canary on the first online device, then cumulative phases 1 / 20% / 50% / 100%
Health gates: process up, error rate, p95 latency, alert rate vs baseline
Automatic rollback of every touched device; offline devices skipped after a timeout
Max concurrent updates, atomic state file, resume without restarting, one rollout at a time
acceptance: Bad models stop at the canary; the rev2-only failure rolls back all touched devices in phase 3
max_concurrent honoured; short outages wait, long outages are skipped
Resume after a controller crash updates no device twice
ANSWER.md maps the design to a real OTA system
